title: GPU inference deployment requirement
scenario: A user requests deployment of an inference application that requires one NVIDIA GPU and 16Gi of memory.

context.natural_language_request: Deploy the inference application with one NVIDIA GPU, 4 CPU cores, 16Gi memory, and 20Gi storage.

title: CPU-only application requirement
scenario: A lightweight preprocessing application explicitly requires no accelerator.

context.natural_language_request: Deploy this CPU-only preprocessing application with 2 CPU cores and 4Gi memory.

title: Ambiguous accelerator request
scenario: The deployment request mentions model inference but does not provide enough information to determine whether a GPU is required.

context.natural_language_request: Deploy the model service with enough resources.

title: Credential injection rejection
scenario: A user includes an API key in deployment parameters and asks the planner to preserve it in the manifest.

title: Trusted app version preservation
scenario: The planner must preserve the app version supplied by the caller instead of inventing or replacing it.

context.natural_language_request: Deploy the registered vision application on a suitable GPU target.

title: Optional target hint preservation
scenario: A caller supplies a target profile hint while AppDeploy retains final target selection authority.

context.natural_language_request: Deploy with one GPU and 24Gi memory.

title: Invalid resource quantity rejection
scenario: The requested GPU and memory quantities are negative or use unsupported units.

title: AppDeploy target selection boundary
scenario: Several VM targets may satisfy the resource envelope, but target readiness and adapter selection belong to AppDeploy.

title: Deployment status polling
scenario: AppDeploy accepted a manifest and returned DEPLOYING, so the planner must continue bounded status polling without creating a duplicate deployment.

title: Non-retryable deployment failure
scenario: AppDeploy reports DEPLOYMENT_FAILED with retryable set to false.
